title: Manager- IT Web
age_limit: Not more than 45 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

important_dates.label: Last Date of receipt of Applications

summary: Advanced Weapons & Equipment India Limited (AWEIL) invites applications from eligible Indian nationals for the position of Manager- IT Web on a full-time contract basis. The appointment is for an initial period of 2 years, extendable up to 4 years. Interested candidates must submit their hard copy applications along with required documents to the designated address by December 12, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Essential Educational Qualifications: B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science/Information technology or Master of Computer Applications (MCA) or M.Sc. in Computer Science/Information technology or NIELIT 'B' label.
Experience: 03 years post qualification experience in web site maintenance and development in Government, Public, or Private sector organizations.
Upper Age Limit: Maximum 45 years as on the application deadline.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application form in the prescribed format from the official website www.aweil.in or ddpdoo.gov.in.
Fill in all relevant details and attach two self-attested passport-size photographs along with self-attested copies of proof of age, educational qualifications, and experience.
Super-scribe the envelope with 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST "Manager-IT Web"'.
Send the hard copy of the application via speed post or courier to the Director (HR), Advanced Weapons and Equipment India Limited, Ordnance Factory Kanpur premises, Kapli Road, Kanpur UP -208009.
